name: Trend of the Universal Market
desc:
The planet is receiving a revaluation...
"Will this project show that it's mutually beneficial to collect any outstanding debts?"
"But we only need to convey one message — our existence."
"If it were to have a value of its own, then it must create value for the corporation."

ability.name: A New Round of Shuffling
ability.desc: Increases the wearer's DEF by {0}%. When the wearer is attacked, there is a {1}% base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to {2}% of the wearer's DEF for 2 turn(s).
